usedFor: Each “New Task Created in Selected Project” in Asana is announced in a Slack channel.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Selected Project” in Asana, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Buttons or a form let people take a task from Slack without opening Asana.

watchOut: The trigger polls and fires oldest first, so a burst of tasks arrives together in Slack.
